name: Choujigen Douraku after
source:
The fan sequel to Cream Lemon's iconic episode: SF Superdimension Legend Rall
After the demon king is suppressed, the heroic daughter who passed into legend continues her life. She thinks of the boy she loves while a middle aged village leader seduces her...

Based on the original story but in an alternate world.
While training to become a queen she gets coerced... her purity begins to tarnish as she gets NTR’d.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106542.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Cream Lemon标志性剧集的粉丝续集：SF Superdimension Legend Rall魔王被镇压后，传说中的英雄女儿继续着自己的生活。当一位中年村长引诱她时，她想起了她所爱的男孩……

基于原始故事，但发生在另一个世界。
在训练成为女王的过程中，她受到了胁迫……随着她被NTR化，她的纯洁性开始受到玷污。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106542.html]DLsite English[/url]]
